concerns.text: Task T013 (Curate dataset) depends on T012 (Implement verifier) and T000a (Schema). However, T013 is marked [ ] (pending) while T012 is [X] (complete). The task description for T013 states: 'Must use the verifier from T012 to validate generated puzzles'. This creates a valid dependency chain, BUT T011 (Implement generator) is marked [X] (complete) and listed AFTER T013 in the file order. T013 consumes the generator (T011) to create data. The order T013 -> T011 violates 'Producer before consumer' (T011 produces the generator logic T013 consumes). T011 must precede T013.

Task T029 (Scalability analysis) depends on T024 (BES loop) and T026 (metrics). T024 is marked [X] (complete) and T026 is [X] (complete). However, T029 is listed AFTER T030a and T030b (Entry points). If T029 is an analysis task, it logically follows the *execution* of T030a/b. The current order places T029 before the execution tasks (T030a/b), implying analysis before data generation. T029 should follow T030a/b.
